name: Aberrant Sorcery

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 PHB; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

summary: Magic seeded by an alien mind: psionic spells, telepathy and flesh that warps toward the strange.

feature.name: Psionic Spells
feature.summary: Arms of Hadar, Calm Emotions, Detect Thoughts, Dissonant Whispers and Mind Sliver always prepared; more at levels 5, 7 and 9.
feature.text: When you reach a Sorcerer level shown, you always have these spells prepared; they don't count against your Prepared Spells: Arms of Hadar, Calm Emotions, Detect Thoughts, Dissonant Whispers and Mind Sliver (3); Hunger of Hadar and Sending (5); Evard's Black Tentacles and Summon Aberration (7); Rary's Telepathic Bond and Telekinesis (9).

feature.name: Telepathic Speech
feature.summary: Bonus Action: form a telepathic link with a creature within 30 feet for Sorcerer-level minutes.
feature.text: As a Bonus Action you can link minds with one creature you can see within 30 feet of you. Until the link ends, the two of you can speak telepathically while within a number of miles of each other equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum one mile), as long as each of you knows a language. The link lasts a number of minutes equal to your Sorcerer level and ends early if you use this feature on another creature.

feature.name: Psionic Sorcery
feature.summary: Cast your level 1+ Psionic Spells with Sorcery Points equal to their level, with no Verbal or Somatic components.
feature.text: When you cast a level 1+ spell from your Psionic Spells feature, you can spend Sorcery Points equal to the spell's level instead of a spell slot. Cast that way it needs no Verbal or Somatic components, nor Material ones unless they are consumed by the spell or have a listed cost.

feature.name: Psychic Defenses
feature.summary: Resistance to Psychic damage and Advantage on saves against Charmed and Frightened.
feature.text: You have Resistance to Psychic damage, and you have Advantage on saving throws to avoid or end the Charmed or Frightened condition.

feature.name: Revelation in Flesh
feature.summary: Spend Sorcery Points for 10 minutes of aberrant traits: a Fly or Swim Speed, seeing the Invisible, or squeezing through tiny gaps.

feature.name: Warping Implosion
feature.summary: Teleport up to 120 feet; creatures near where you left are pulled in for 3d10 Force damage (Strength save halves).
